[1/2] UI cycle: add a NO RESERVE second line to the near-crosshair low-ammo panel when the magazine runs dry, with a HUD pair and dry-fire parity

impact_assessment.why: The cycle-55 panel shows LOW AMMO <mag> but never says the reserve is empty, so the warning implies a reload will help when it cannot.
impact_assessment.benefits: The player can tell an empty reserve from an ordinary low magazine at the aim point; full counts stay in the engine status.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, ammo, input or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first label tests, the hud_ammo capture pair at 960x540, dry-fire hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Graphics cycle: burst the existing pickup orb for 0.30 s on collection, with DATA-tuned growth/rise, a staged pair and pickup-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: Collecting the surge pickup vanishes the beam and orb instantly; the only payoff is a caption, so a major power-up has no world-space effect.
impact_assessment.benefits: A short expanding, rising orb pop marks the collection using the existing node and material, with no new nodes or draw types.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: presentation timer and orb transform only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, pickup trigger, ammo or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first burst/clear tests, a staged pickup pair at 960x540, pickup-drill hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Audio cycle: give critical kills a distinct high chime and CRITICAL caption, with a forced-critical pair, campaign clip count and WAV probe

impact_assessment.why: Critical kills roll at 12% and pay double bounty, but only the generic kill voice and a larger score pop mark them; the reward is not legible as critical.
impact_assessment.benefits: A 1760 Hz chime plus CRITICAL caption distinguishes the reward without touching the roll, bounty, kill feed or sim state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, reward RNG or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first forced-critical tests, a seeded critical pair, a 3000-frame campaign clip count and a WAV/spectrogram probe.

[1/2] Progression cycle: surface a disabled profile in the debrief, with a schema-99 pair and profile_bad death drill

impact_assessment.why: An unsupported profile schema sets profile_disabled and _save_profile returns early, so the run debrief looks normal while nothing can be saved; the player is never told.
impact_assessment.benefits: A red PROFILE DISABLED line tells the player persistence is off, without touching the refusal or overwrite guards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: debrief draw only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile schema policy and save path unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first debrief test, a schema-99 capture pair, a profile_bad death drill and the full gates.

[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: dip the existing viewmodel while reloading, with a mid-reload pair and reload-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The reload bar and completion cue exist, but the first-person gun stays rigidly at hip during the whole reload, so the weapon feels static while the magazine fills.
impact_assessment.benefits: A DATA-driven sine dip lowers and pulls back the gun during reload and returns it at completion, using the existing nodes and no new draws.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: viewmodel presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, ammo, timing or input change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dip/return tests, a mid-reload capture pair at 960x540, reload-drill hash parity and the full gates.

[1/2] Enemies cycle: reject warden escort positions that overlap the boss or an existing escort, re-record the fairness reference and prove with a centre-summon pair and drill

impact_assessment.why: Cover-safe summon placement still allowed escorts inside the warden (ring starts at 1.2 m vs boss 1.0 m + mite 0.5 m) and overlapping each other.
impact_assessment.benefits: Escorts now spawn with real clearance around the boss and each other, so they can path and attack instead of clipping.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: summon placement and fairness fixture; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic RNG order, count and max_alive retained.
impact_assessment.mitigation: 40-seed overlap test, seed-12 capture pair, summon_overlap drill with spawn telemetry, and a re-recorded winning reference replayed by the fairness test.
